questions.q: What color is a stop sign?
questions.fact: A stop sign has eight sides.

questions.q: What does a green traffic light mean?
questions.fact: Traffic lights help cars take turns.

questions.q: How many wheels does a car usually have?
questions.fact: Some cars carry a spare tire in the trunk.

questions.q: What can a car use to go?
questions.fact: An electric car has a battery instead of a gas tank.

questions.q: What color is a school bus in North America?
questions.fact: School buses are painted bright yellow so they are easy to spot.

questions.q: What do windshield wipers wipe off the window?
questions.fact: Wipers sweep back and forth across the front window.

questions.q: Which vehicle has wings and flies?
questions.fact: Airplanes take off and land on a long runway.

questions.q: Which vehicle rides on tracks?
questions.fact: A train can pull many cars at once.

questions.q: What do we call a road that goes through a mountain?
questions.fact: A tunnel can go through a mountain or under water.

questions.q: What crosses over a river so cars can drive across?
questions.fact: The Golden Gate Bridge is painted a bright orange color.

questions.q: Which animal is on a moose crossing sign?
questions.fact: Moose are the biggest members of the deer family.

questions.q: What game starts with "I spy with my little eye"?
questions.fact: I Spy is a guessing game you can play anywhere.

questions.q: Where do cars fill up with gas?
questions.fact: Many gas stations also sell snacks.

questions.q: What shape is a yield sign?
questions.fact: A yield sign tells drivers to let others go first.

questions.q: Which side of the road do cars drive on in the U.S. and Canada?
questions.fact: In the United Kingdom and Japan, cars drive on the left.

questions.q: What do the numbers on a highway exit sign, like Exit 42, help you do?
questions.fact: In many places, exit numbers match the mile markers.

questions.q: What does a yellow diamond-shaped road sign usually do?
questions.fact: Yellow diamond signs warn about things like curves or animals crossing.

questions.q: In the U.S. Interstate system, which way do highways with odd numbers run?
questions.fact: Interstate 5 runs up the west coast and Interstate 95 runs up the east coast.

questions.q: Which Interstate runs all the way along the East Coast?
questions.fact: Interstate 95 goes from Florida to Maine.

questions.q: What does mph stand for?
questions.fact: Canada uses kilometers per hour, or km/h, for speed limits.

questions.q: What does a speedometer show?
o: How fast the car is going
questions.fact: A speedometer needle or number moves as the car speeds up.

questions.q: What is a rest area?
o: A place off the highway to stop and stretch
questions.fact: Many rest areas have picnic tables and restrooms.

questions.q: What is the Trans-Canada Highway?
o: A road that crosses all of Canada
questions.fact: The Trans-Canada Highway is more than 7,000 kilometers long.

questions.q: Which famous old highway is nicknamed the Mother Road?
questions.fact: Route 66 ran from Chicago to Santa Monica.

questions.q: Which Ontario highway is one of the busiest in North America?
questions.fact: In parts of Toronto, Highway 401 is up to 18 lanes wide.

questions.q: Which famous San Francisco bridge is painted International Orange?
questions.fact: The Golden Gate Bridge opened in 1937.

questions.q: What is a detour?
o: A different route around a blocked road
questions.fact: Detour signs show the way around the closed part.

questions.q: What does RV stand for?
questions.fact: Many RVs have a bed, a kitchen and a bathroom inside.

questions.q: Which national park is home to the Old Faithful geyser?
questions.fact: Old Faithful erupts about every hour and a half.

questions.q: Which national park is famous for El Capitan, a giant granite cliff?
questions.fact: El Capitan rises about 3,000 feet from the valley floor.

questions.q: Which Canadian national park has Lake Louise?
questions.fact: Lake Louise looks turquoise because of tiny bits of rock ground up by glaciers.

questions.q: The Alaska Highway begins in Dawson Creek in which Canadian province?
questions.fact: The Alaska Highway was built in 1942 in about eight months.

questions.q: In which U.S. state is Mount Rushmore?
questions.fact: The faces carved into Mount Rushmore are each about 60 feet tall.

questions.q: Which U.S. city is home to the Space Needle?
questions.fact: The Space Needle was built for the 1962 World's Fair.

questions.q: Which U.S. state is nicknamed the Lone Star State?
questions.fact: The Texas flag has one big white star.

questions.q: Which Canadian province is known for the Cabot Trail?
questions.fact: The Cabot Trail loops around Cape Breton Island.

questions.q: The Calgary Stampede is held in which city?
questions.fact: The Calgary Stampede happens every July.

questions.q: Vancouver sits on the coast of which ocean?
questions.fact: Vancouver is squeezed between mountains and the sea.

questions.q: What does an odometer show?
o: How far the car has traveled
questions.fact: An odometer counts every mile a car has driven in its life.

questions.q: In which U.S. state is the Grand Canyon?
questions.fact: The Grand Canyon is about 277 miles long.

questions.q: Which U.S. city has a famous stainless steel arch called the Gateway Arch?
questions.fact: The Gateway Arch is 630 feet tall, the tallest human-made monument in the U.S.

questions.q: Which Canadian province is home to Niagara Falls?
questions.fact: Niagara Falls is on the border between Ontario and New York.
